coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth variable items (45%): empirical versus theoretical ZB-2p scheduling, ideal communication overlap, computed versus actual timelines, bubble-rate measurement, and analysis of execution alignment.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed 14.6B model with 8B/70B models and varies pipeline size and microbatch count instead of fixing 16 stages and 64 microbatches. Specifies a general 2p memory constraint rather than the required enable flag and fixed limit of 32. Includes Nsight tracing but omits the specified export/custom Python/SVG workflow. Uses MFU and step time rather than samples per second per GPU. Adds numerous experimental factors outside the ground-truth design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state the expected near-zero bubble rate, generally below 1%, with only minor real-world overhead and validation through high throughput and close theoretical–actual timeline alignment.
